title: C1 calibrated grasp: hypothesis and prerequisite test protocol

execution.remaining_protocol_tests: not executed; helper unit tests do not certify physical gates

frozen_conditions: v32 physics, camera, friction, object scale and original task predicates
six-second task clock including settling; no reset/extension during assistance
matched simulator initial states; remote diffusion seed explicitly uncontrolled
privileged object pose and diagnostic contacts available equally to applicable controller conditions
launch_rule: Block development until required calibration parameters are measured, frozen and hashed, and prerequisite tests pass. Null is unknown, not a default.

tests.claim: Reference records can support a trustworthy native replay and a separately validated joint/WBC replay.
tests.procedure: Audit original HDF5, source scene provenance, 23D native actions, 43D processed targets, 50D runtime mapping and sample alignment. Evaluate replay with active independent task/retention diagnostics.
tests.pass: All selected calibration/validation replays have explicit scene/action provenance and hard-bounded replay errors; success is independently observed.
tests.failure_action: Do not fit calibration from reward=1, success attributes alone, or printed replay warnings. Resolve mapping or collect new provenance-complete reference data.

tests.claim: The selected grasp frame is rigid and its object-relative target is geometrically consistent.
tests.procedure: Verify actual USD frames; finger sweep with fixed wrist; FK/Jacobian finite differences; quaternion round trip; common-world-transform invariance. Fit three verified demonstrations, validate on two disjoint ones.
tests.pass: Rigid-frame and transform tests meet preregistered tolerances; held-out demonstrations enter their retained grasp modes without post-hoc fitting.
tests.failure_action: Reject frame/mode calibration, not silently increase positional tolerance.

tests.claim: The retention observer distinguishes capture from support, touch, tilt and release.
tests.procedure: Separate apple-hand and apple-support diagnostic channels without changing apple-plate scoring. Check support-only, hand-table/no-apple, unilateral touch, captured hold, tilt/bounce and released-object cases.
tests.pass: Negative controls cannot satisfy audited retention; captured positive control passes; unresolved/overflowed channels return unknown and prevent certification.
tests.failure_action: Stop scored controller trials until observer validity is restored.

tests.claim: Controller takeover and resumption neither consume stale chunks nor corrupt WBC/episode state.
tests.procedure: Use tagged synthetic actions/observations, including delayed responses. Assert no base chunk consumption during owned phases, local invalidation on handover, fresh post-intervention observation ID, bounded command continuity and unchanged episode clock.
tests.pass: No pre-takeover queued action executes after handover; no unwanted remote/episode/WBC reset; inactive joints/tail and per-step WBC remain valid.
tests.failure_action: Fix scheduler/lifecycle contract before robot testing; do not call blending alone RTC.

tests.null: Calibrated retargeting does not reduce closure-time grasp-pose error relative to raw policy.
tests.alternative: Calibrated retargeting reduces closure-time translation/orientation error without forbidden contacts.
tests.comparison: B spatial-only versus A raw; original finger timing preserved in B.
tests.endpoint: Pose error at actual closure; alignment rate; retained grasp and task success reported separately.
tests.interpretation: Three development attempts per condition are mechanism screening, not a powered hypothesis test.

tests.null: Coordinated phase control adds no retained-grasp benefit beyond spatial retargeting.
tests.alternative: Coordinated phases improve audited retention at the same calibrated target.
tests.comparison: D combined versus B spatial-only; C coordination-only uses the policy-selected arm goal, not an unreachable calibrated-goal requirement.
tests.endpoint: Audited retention, phase failures, closure timing and original task success; log every timeout as failure rather than readiness.
tests.interpretation: Coordination is a package including chunk ownership and measured tracking; do not call its effect a pure finger-delay effect.

tests.null: Fresh policy resumption fails to preserve an already verified grasp.
tests.alternative: The frozen policy preserves retention and completes transport after assistance relinquishes control.
tests.procedure: For every verified hold, record pre/post-handover contact, object-hand motion, executed command jump and first fresh-chunk finger targets.
tests.endpoint: Retained-to-lost transition and audited placement within the unchanged task horizon.
tests.failure_action: Separate grasp-controller success from policy-transfer failure; do not covertly extend supervisor transport authority.

tests.null: The selected assisted controller provides no audited-placement improvement over unassisted policy on held-out layouts.
tests.alternative: The frozen selected controller improves audited placement on held-out layouts.
tests.design: Ten cases per condition: original pose plus four feasible unseen apple-XY layouts, two simulator seeds each. Report original-pose cases separately from eight held-out cases. Freeze cases before development.
tests.endpoint: Original task success AND separately audited retained transport/release; report counts, layout-level differences and uncertainty.
tests.advance_rule: Engineering milestone only: at least one audited placement at original v32 and on at least two distinct held-out layouts, observed held-out improvement over baseline, and no serious safeguard violation.
tests.interpretation: Not a significance/power guarantee. No post-hoc extra trials to obtain a desired p-value.

tests.null: Relational graph retrieval provides no budgeted adaptation advantage over matched flat retrieval or no-history search.
tests.alternative: Graph-informed selection improves audited placement per simulation budget across held-out scene families.
tests.design: Same controller, calibration corpus, observations, parameter bounds, proposer and trial budget. Compare relational graph, flat-memory retrieval with the same facts, and no-history search; optionally shuffled relations as a negative control.
tests.endpoint: Budget-indexed audited success, attempts to first success, final held-out performance and intervention burden; failures/timeouts consume budget.
tests.leakage_rule: Freeze initial memory; each search strategy owns its own development updates. No cross-arm or test-outcome leakage. Group splits by source demonstration and scene family.
tests.interpretation: Not covered by the 42-attempt feasibility budget and not evidence supplied by successful graph writes.
